title: CWP/16745/2025 of SAURABH MODI AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 115 CWP-16745-2025 Date of Decision : July 29, 2025 SAURABH MODI AND OTHERS .....Petitioners VERSUS STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS .....Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ROHIT KAPOOR Present : Mr. M.S.Rana, Advocate for the petitioners. ROHIT KAPOOR, J. (Oral)

1. In the present writ petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, prayer is made for issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus for issuance of directions to respondents No.1 and 2 to conduct Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) of IHM Yamunanagar after the merger of all societies of all IHMs in the State of Haryana.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, on instructions from the petitioners, submits that at this stage, the petitioner will be satisfied if a direction is given to respondent No.1 to decide their representation dated 13.5.2025 (Annexure P-8), in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion.

4. Mr. Piyush Khanna, Addl. AG, Haryana accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.1 and Mr. Naman Jain, Standing Counsel accept notice on behalf of respondents No.2 and 3 and they do not oppose the prayer, as made by the learned counsel for the petitioners.

5. In view of the above and without commenting upon the merits of the case, the present writ petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to respondent No.1 to decide representation dated 13.5.2025 (Annexure P-8), within a period of 08 weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

6. Needless to say that the representation shall be decided in adherence with the principles of natural justice by giving due opportunity of hearing to the petitioners and by passing a detailed and reasoned speaking order.

7. Disposed of in the aforesaid terms. (ROHIT KAPOOR) July 29, 2025 JUDGE ajaysharma Chandigarh
